## Fix log

### 2026-06-15 — honor PreToolUse `input.cwd` (commit `887b7096ad`, slot:oscar)

**Symptom:** a bare `git commit` (no `git -C <dir>` flag, no leading `cd <dir> &&`) issued from a
slot worktree was false-blocked — the deny message reported `commit cwd: H:/prism` /
`current branch: cad-fusion-live-ms0` even though the chat's real cwd was its `H:/prism-slot-<name>`
worktree (already on `slot/<name>`). Forced repeated `PRISM_SLOT_COMMIT_ENFORCE_DISABLE=1` /
`cd <worktree> &&` workarounds (6× this oscar session alone).

**Root cause:** `resolveGitCwd(cmd)` resolved the git cwd *only* from the command string
(`git -C` → `cd` prefix → else `DEFAULT_GIT_CWD = "H:/prism"`). With neither prefix present it fell
to the main-tree default and read the wrong branch. The PreToolUse payload already carries the real
working dir as `input.cwd` (sibling hooks `main-tree-write-block` / `git-add-lane-guard` already use
it), but this hook ignored it.

**Fix:** `resolveGitCwd(cmd, input)` now consults `input.cwd` *after* `-C`/`cd` and *before* the
`H:/prism` fallback. Fail-soft: a missing/blank `input.cwd` preserves the prior fallback exactly.

**Validated (mock stdin, this session):** worktree cwd → `ALLOW on-slot-branch` (exit 0, was DENY);
main-tree cwd → `DENY` (exit 2). Strictly more correct — never weakens a genuine main-tree block.
Memory: [[feedback_slot_commit_use_git_dash_c]].
